title: Crisp Olive Oil Grissini with Sea Salt
summary: A plain olive oil dough is risen, rolled and cut into strips, stretched into 30 cm ropes, brushed with oil, sprinkled with flaky salt and baked until crisp through.
equipment: large bowl or stand mixer with dough hook
2 large baking trays lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, water and olive oil 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave 1-1.5 hours until doubled.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Roll the dough into a 30 x 20 cm rectangle and cut into 30 strips.

steps.title: Stretch
steps.text: Roll each strip into a 30 cm rope and lay on the trays.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Brush with oil, sprinkle with flaky salt and bake 15-20 minutes until golden and crisp. Cool on the trays.

tips: If a rope springs back, let it rest a moment and roll again.
Cool completely before storing or they soften.
storage: Store in an airtight tin at room temperature for up to 1 week. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
